description: This file declares comparison and search functions for vector spans, including equality check, element find, maximum absolute value in complex spans, maximum value in real spans, and counting samples exceeding a threshold, within the ocudu::ocuduvec namespace.

methods.name: equal
methods.description: Checks if two span-compatible containers are equal.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a byte-wide value in a span.

methods.name: max_abs_element
methods.description: Finds the index and squared magnitude of the maximum absolute value in a complex span.

methods.name: max_element
methods.description: Finds the index and value of the maximum element in a float span.

methods.name: count_if_part_abs_greater_than
methods.description: Counts samples in a complex span where real or imaginary parts exceed a threshold.
